name: maphash
algorithm: Hash map churn with each language's standard map and its default hash: n splitmix64-mixed u64 keys inserted, each looked up once with a hit and once with a miss, every other key removed, all n looked up again; rounds times with a fresh map (README.md).

skip.c: no standard hash map in C
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

notes: Default hashes: Mk the fold hash (DD-5), Rust SipHash-1-3 under a random key (RandomState), Zig std.hash.autoHash (wyhash, seed 0), Go the runtime map hash (AES-based with AES-NI, seeded per map).

Publish size 3000000 3 1 (SH-4): at 1000000 3 1 the fastest cell (Zig) ran about 0.4 s in the lane's informal runs, under the 1 s floor; three times n projects it to about 1.2 s until a tools/bench publish times it.
Written by the std-hash lane (status/std-hash.md); checksums agree across all four columns at both sizes on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06.
